description: Search published Community Days events by keyword. Returns up to 20 matching events: upcoming events first (soonest first), then past events (most recent first). Each event's last_update is when its own team last changed it, or its status last changed (sent for approval, published, cancelled and the like); a fix by a Community Days administrator doesn't move it. Older events may have no last_update, or one a few hours off. Each event's social_links are its own links: each has a platform (such as x, linkedin, meetup or youtube) and a handle, the end of the page's address after the site name; for blog, website and newsletter the handle is the full web address. A newsletter link is the event's newsletter, which people can subscribe to.

q.description: Search keyword (case-insensitive, diacritic-insensitive — 'sao' matches 'São'). A state's name also finds events saved under its code and the other way round ('Tennessee' finds TN); a two-letter code finds that state only

name: search_events
